# express-boilerplate

> A production-grade, multi-tenant SaaS API boilerplate built on Express 5
> + TypeScript with a strict two-layer architecture (no React, no Next.js):
> framework-agnostic business logic (`modules/`), Express bindings
> (`modules_express/`), and routes wired in `router/`. The module set
> mirrors the sister project next-boilerplate.

This file follows the llms.txt convention so AI agents can quickly orient
without grepping the codebase. A full, machine-readable catalog of every
module, Express route, TypeORM entity, and middleware is served from
`public/registry/`.

## Machine-readable catalog

- **Full registry (JSON):** `/registry/registry.json`
- **Lightweight index (JSON, no inlined READMEs):** `/registry/registry.index.json`
- **Surface-by-surface:** `/registry/modules.json`, `/registry/routes.json`, `/registry/entities.json`, `/registry/components.json`
- **JSON Schema for validation:** `/schemas/registry-v1.json`
- **Per-module markdown chunks:** `/modules/<id>.md`
- **Markdown chunk index:** `/modules/_index.json`

Rebuild any time the codebase changes:

```bash
npm run registry:snapshot
```

The full registry includes for every:

- **Module** (~41): `id`, `name`, `version`, `description`, `dir`, `tier`,
  `tags`, `dependencies.{requires,optional,conflicts}`, `exports.*`
  (services, dtos, entities, enums, messageKeys, settingKeys, providers,
  jobs), `hasExpressLayer`, and inlined `README.md`.
- **Route** (~109): `filePath`, `scope` (system|tenant), `urlPath`
  (composed from scope prefix + mount path + handler path), `method`,
  owning `module` (derived from router filename), `dynamic` flag.
- **Entity** (~30 TypeORM `@Entity` classes): `name`, `filePath`,
  owning `module`, `schema` (system|tenant), `tableName`, `columns[]`,
  `relations[]`.
- **Middleware / service.express** (~7 entries under `modules_express/`):
  `id`, owning `module`, `filePath`, `kind` (`middleware` |
  `service.express` | `other`), named `exports[]`.

## MCP server (Claude Desktop / Cursor / Cline / Windsurf / Zed)

Zero-dependency stdio MCP server. Config in `.mcp.json` at the repo root.
Tools:

- `list_modules` — filter by tier or tag
- `get_module` — by id, returns description, dependencies, exports, README
- `search_modules` — substring search across id + name + description + README
- `list_routes` — filter by scope (system|tenant), method, or module id
- `search_routes` — substring search over urlPath + filePath
- `list_entities` — filter by schema or module
- `get_entity` — by TypeORM class name
- `list_middlewares` — filter by module id or kind
- `get_conventions` — layer rules + naming + scopes + auth + testing + security
- `get_module_readme` — pre-rendered per-module markdown chunk
- `read_file` — read any repo file (sandboxed to the repository root)

Reads from `public/registry/registry.json`. Refresh with `npm run registry:snapshot`.

## Editor-native rule files (mirror of AGENTS.md)

- `.cursor/rules/express-boilerplate.mdc` — Cursor (modern)
- `.cursorrules` — Cursor (legacy)
- `.windsurfrules` — Windsurf
- `.github/copilot-instructions.md` — GitHub Copilot
- `.clinerules` — Cline / Continue.dev

## The two layers (+ router)

- `router/` — Express routing layer. One file per scope/module. Each builds
  a `Router()` and attaches `.get/.post/...` handlers. `router/index.ts` is
  the proxy router — it rewrites `/system/*` and `/tenant/:tenantId/*`
  based on `TENANCY_MODE` (`domain` or `path`).
- `modules_express/` — Express binding layer: middlewares
  (`*.middleware.ts`) and service extensions (`*.service.express.ts`) that
  touch `Request` / `Response`.
- `modules/` — framework-agnostic business logic (services, DTOs,
  entities, types, enums, messages). **No `express`, no `Request`/`Response`,
  no `next/*`, no `react`, no browser APIs.** Importable from any runtime
  (Next.js, CLI scripts, alternate frameworks).

Strict one-way dependency: `router/ → modules_express/ → modules/`. The
reverse is enforced by review.

## Multi-tenant scopes

- **System** (`/system/...`) — super-admin, no tenant context. Routers
  mounted via `router/system/`.
- **Tenant** (`/tenant/:tenantId/...`) — per-tenant. Routers mounted via
  `router/tenant/` using `Router({ mergeParams: true })` so
  `req.params.tenantId` is available downstream.

Per-tenant data lives in a per-tenant TypeORM `DataSource` via
`modules/db`. **Never share a DataSource across scopes.**

## Conventions (must follow)

- **File naming:** `*.service.ts`, `*.dto.ts`, `*.types.ts`, `*.enums.ts`,
  `*.messages.ts`, `*.setting.keys.ts`, `*.entity.ts` (under `entities/`),
  `*.provider.ts`, `*.job.ts`, `*.middleware.ts` (modules_express/ only),
  `*.service.express.ts` (modules_express/ only), `*.test.ts` colocated.
- **Path alias:** only `@/* → ./*` is configured.
- **Auth:** JWT (httpOnly cookies + Bearer header), OTP, TOTP, SAML, OAuth
  (12+ providers), WebAuthn/Passkeys. `AuthMiddleware(role)` factory at
  `modules_express/auth/auth.middleware.ts`.
- **Validation:** Zod everywhere. `DTO.safeParse(req.body)` + throw
  `AppError(..., 400, ErrorCode.VALIDATION_ERROR)` on failure.
- **Error handling:** Throw `AppError` from `@/modules/common/app-error`.
  Single funnel: `errorHandler` middleware in
  `modules_express/common/error-handler.middleware.ts`.
- **Database:** TypeORM, dual-schema (system + per-tenant). Get a
  DataSource via `modules/db`.
- **Cache / queue:** Redis (`modules/redis`) + BullMQ.
- **Settings:** Per-module `*.setting.keys.ts` declares the key enum;
  `modules/setting` is the read/write path.
- **Logging:** `@/modules/logger` (Winston). Never `console.*` in service code.
- **Tests:** Jest, colocated as `*.test.ts`.

## Where to put new code

- Pure business logic / entity / DTO → `modules/<id>/`
- TypeORM entity → `modules/<id>/entities/<x>.entity.ts`
- BullMQ job processor → `modules/<id>/<x>.job.ts`
- Pluggable provider → `modules/<id>/providers/<x>.provider.ts`
- Express middleware for a module → `modules_express/<id>/<id>.middleware.ts`
- Express service extension → `modules_express/<id>/<id>.service.express.ts`
- Express router → `router/<scope>/<id>.ts` + mount in `router/<scope>/index.ts`
- One-off CLI → `scripts/<name>.{ts,mjs}`

## How to use this catalog from an AI agent

1. Fetch `/registry/registry.index.json` for a fast scan of every module + route + entity + middleware.
2. Filter `modules[]` by `tier` / `tags` to find the right module.
3. Fetch `/modules/<id>.md` for the per-module deep dive (README + dependency map + owned routes/entities/middleware).
4. Fetch `/registry/registry.json` (or read the file at `filePath`) when you need full source-of-truth content.
5. Follow `dependencies.requires[]` (when present) to discover what else you must import.
